id.description: A content id, `mod:id`. Without a prefix it resolves to the Mod that writes it. ASCII only, so Go and JS sort ids the same way.

localId.description: An id local to one definition, such as a map's Planet ids. No namespace.

asset.description: An asset in a Mod's assets/ folder, written `__mod__/path`.

classStats.title: Class Stats
classStats.description: A Unit Class's default Battle stats.

richness.description: Per Resource id, how much a Planet's extractor buildings draw from it: none ×0, poor ×0.5, normal ×1, rich ×1.5. A Resource left out is none.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Units in one Stack, one entry per Unit Slot.

stacks.description: Up to a Planet's three Stacks, first Stack first.

combat.title: Combat
combat.description: Battle stats. A Unit Class missing from tiers counts as `normal`.

damage.description: The damage roll, in dice notation: NdM, or NdM+K.

speed.description: Cells per second; defaults from the Ruleset's battle.classDefaults.

range.description: Farthest it fires, in cells; defaults from battle.classDefaults.

minRange.description: Closest it fires, in cells (artillery). Defaults to 0.

fireInterval.description: Seconds between volleys; defaults from battle.classDefaults.

sight.description: Sight radius in cells; defaults from battle.classDefaults.

tiers.description: Per Unit Class id, how this attacker rolls against it: advantage rolls the to-hit and damage twice and keeps the higher, disadvantage keeps the lower, none can't target it.
